questions.question: Why is security architecture design especially important for AI applications?
choices: AI apps are always open-source so security is handled by the community
AI apps handle sensitive data, model access, and API keys, creating unique attack surfaces beyond traditional web apps
Security only matters for apps with payment processing
AI models are inherently secure because they only predict text
questions.explanation: AI applications introduce unique security concerns: model inference endpoints can be abused, training data may contain sensitive information, API keys grant powerful access, and prompt injection can bypass intended behavior.

questions.question: What is the principle of least privilege in the context of AI system security?
choices: Giving every component full access to simplify development
Granting each component only the minimum permissions it needs to perform its function
Using the smallest possible model to reduce attack surface
Limiting user input to a single sentence
questions.explanation: Least privilege means each service, component, or user gets only the permissions required for their specific role. This limits damage from breaches — if one component is compromised, it can't access everything.

questions.question: Which of the following is a critical security concern specific to LLM-powered applications?
choices: SQL injection attacks on the database
Cross-site scripting in the HTML template
Prompt injection that causes the model to bypass safety rules or leak sensitive data
Outdated CSS styles that look unprofessional
questions.explanation: Prompt injection is an attack where malicious input tricks an LLM into ignoring its instructions, revealing system prompts, or performing unintended actions. It's a unique vulnerability of AI applications.
